title: Arlyxir
summary: Keep Arlyxir inside his room and finish before his rebirth heal.
overview: Keep Arlyxir inside his room and finish before his rebirth heal.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Maintain damage and keep the tank safely inside the room.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: The boss checks his room boundary every six seconds. Crossing south of it heals him fully, returns him to bind and clears hate.
After 12.5 minutes of continuous combat, Arlyxir heals and casts Searing Flames.
Victory creates a planar projection for progression.

notes: Approval E302. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
